text: dsh-relaycheck 是一个面向 DSH 的工具插件，通过 relay_check 调用 relaycheck 检查已配置的 LLM API 中转目标。用户可以选择目标和模型，并运行身份指纹、协议字段、计费用量及上下文长度检查；工具将各组状态、结论、用量和耗时整理为文本报告。目标地址和密钥变量名由插件配置提供，也可以按当前会话的 provider 选择目标。适合需要核对模型中转服务是否符合预期的 DSH 用户。运行时会向配置的中转地址发送检查请求，并从环境变量读取密钥；默认在运行前请求批准。

dsh-relaycheck adds relay_check to DSH to check a configured LLM relay's identity, protocol, billing usage, and context length. It returns a verdict and usage summary. The API key comes from an environment variable, and checks request approval by default.
我想确认配置的模型中转实际返回的是不是指定模型。
检查一下 LLM API 的计费 token 数和真实用量是否对得上。
I want to verify that my configured model relay behaves like the model it claims to serve.
dsh-relaycheck 的功能「检查中转一致性」：调用 relay_check 后，插件针对配置目标运行身份、协议、计费和上下文检查，并返回各组状态、整体结论及用量摘要。目标和模型可由参数指定，或依据当前会话 provider 选择。
dsh-relaycheck 的功能「检查前确认」：默认在 relay_check 执行前向用户请求批准，并说明检查会向中转发送多次请求并消耗 token；可通过 requireApproval 配置控制此确认流程。
dsh-relaycheck 使用前须知：每次检查会向配置的中转服务发送多次请求并消耗该服务 token；插件从目标指定的环境变量读取 API 密钥。

dsh-relaycheck README · dsh-relaycheck：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin that gives the agent a `relay_check` tool: ask it "is this relay really serving the model it claims?" and it runs [relaycheck](https://github.com/YanYunCY/relaycheck) against the relay and reports a verdict.

中文：给 dsh 的 agent 加一个 `relay_check` 工具，用 [relaycheck](https://github.com/YanYunCY/relaycheck) 检测 LLM API 中转是否货真价实（模型是否被调包、计费是否虚报、上下文是否被截断、是否注入隐藏提示词）。

dsh-relaycheck README · What it checks：relaycheck runs four groups against the relay and compares the answers with a reference fingerprint:

| Group | What it catches |
|---|---|
| identity | model swap: 24 probes × N samples, permutation χ² per probe, Cauchy-combined p-value |
| protocol | wrong or missing protocol fields for the claimed API |
| billing | reported `usage` vs. the real token count; hidden prompt injection |
| context | truncated context window (needle test) |
dsh-relaycheck README · What it checks：The verdict is `consistent`, `inconsistent` or `inconclusive`. It is a statistical test, not proof.

dsh-relaycheck README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-relaycheck
```

Requires Node ≥ 24.9 (the same as dsh). Tested with dsh 0.2.1-rc.5.

dsh-relaycheck README · Configure：The model can only name a **configured target**. Base URLs and key variable names live in your profile config, so a prompt injection cannot point your key at another host. Keys are read from environment variables only.

```yaml

dsh-relaycheck README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：- id: relaycheck
  config:
    targets:
      myrelay:
        baseUrl: https://relay.example.com
        model: claude-sonnet-4-5      # optional; empty = the model of the calling session
        api: auto                     # auto | anthropic | openai | responses
        keyEnv: RELAY_KEY             # name of the env var holding the key
        provider: myrelay             # dsh provider id this relay backs (optional)
    samples: 16
    requireApproval: true             # ask before each run; a run spends relay tokens
    allowDeep: false                  # --deep costs about 100k extra input tokens
```

dsh-relaycheck README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：```bash
export RELAY_KEY=sk-...
dsh web
```

When `provider` matches the provider of the current session, the agent can call `relay_check` with no arguments to test "the relay I'm using now", with the session's model.

dsh-relaycheck README · $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml：| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `targets` | `{}` | named relays the agent may check |
| `defaultTarget` | — | used when the call names none and no provider matches |
| `samples` | `16` | samples per identity probe |
| `probes` | `identity,protocol,billing,context` | groups to run |
| `allowDeep` | `false` | let the agent request `--deep` |
| `requireApproval` | `true` | approval prompt before every run |
| `lang` | `en` | `en` or `zh` for the summaries |
| `timeoutSeconds` | `600` | kill the run after this long |

dsh-relaycheck README · The tool：`relay_check({ target?, model?, probes?, deep? })` returns:

```json
{
  "target": "myrelay", "host": "relay.example.com", "model": "claude-sonnet-4-5", "api": "anthropic",
  "verdict": "inconsistent", "headline": "...", "pValue": 0.0003, "calibrated": true,
  "exitCode": 1,

`pValue` and `injectedTokens` are left out when relaycheck reports none. The model sees a short text summary of the same facts. The key never appears in the result or in error messages.

dsh-relaycheck README · Cost：A default run sends a few hundred short requests (24 probes × `samples`, plus protocol, billing and context checks) and takes one to several minutes. That is why `requireApproval` is on by default.

dsh-relaycheck README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test     # unit tests + end-to-end runs against relaycheck's local mock relays (honest and model-swapping); no real API or key
```
